name: enigma-workspace
description: Monorepo for Enigma26 (serverless P2P chat, iroh + MLS) and Morion, the Zinnia file editor. Shared primitives in packages/, shared Rust in crates/.

scripts.test:rust:net: cargo check -p collab --features net && cargo test -p collab --features net && cargo test -p collab --features mls && cargo test -p collab --features "net mls"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:build && npm run test:rust && npm run test:rust:net
